## Why This Is Asked
Tests a beginner's ability to model a data-minimization feature with privacy controls and a practical fiscal lens.

## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to structure a pragmatic CBA for ML deployment, balancing cost with user value, handling uncertainty, and communicating the result.

## Key Concepts
- Cost and benefits modeling
- Time horizon and discounting
- Scenario analysis (base/best/worst)
- Metrics: NPV, ROI, risk-adjusted EV

## Code Example
```javascript
function npv(cashFlows, rate) {
  return cashFlows.reduce((acc, cf, i) => acc + cf / Math.pow(1 + rate, i+1), 0);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle non-linear cost factors (e.g., burst traffic) in your model?
- How would you present results to non-technical stakeholders?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of privacy‑first on-device processing and practical cost modeling. It requires concrete cost categories, rollout strategy, and a measurement plan that ties to business outcomes.

## Key Concepts
- On-device privacy by design and PII redaction

- Rule update cadence and rollout staging
- Measurement plan and break-even horizon
- Risk management: false positives/negatives and UX impact

```
// Redaction sample (simplified)
function redactPII(text){
  return text
    .replace(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/gi, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\b(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

- What metrics would you track for the 12-month CBA, and how would you ethically collect them?

## Why This Is Asked

Evaluates ability to reason comprehensively about edge ML deployment economics, privacy constraints, and practical implementation challenges in production environments.

## Key Concepts

- Edge compute resource optimization and budgeting
- Model efficiency and parameter scaling strategies
- Energy consumption impact measurement and optimization
- Privacy-preserving telemetry and data governance
- Phased rollout methodologies and risk mitigation
- Cost-benefit analysis frameworks and break-even modeling

## Code Example

```javascript
function calculateBreakEven(bandwidthSavedPerUser, monthlyActiveUsers, costPerGB, operationalCosts) {
  const monthlyBandwidthSavings = bandwidthSavedPerUser * monthlyActiveUsers * costPerGB;
  const netSavings = monthlyBandwidthSavings - operationalCosts;
  const breakEvenMonths = Math.ceil(initialInvestment / netSavings);
  return breakEvenMonths;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you model the diminishing returns of model size increases versus inference quality?
- What privacy compliance frameworks would you consider for delta telemetry collection?
- How would you optimize the update cadence based on user engagement patterns?
